name: gcloud-guard
description: Holds gcloud and gsutil commands that would create, change or delete cloud resources, shows the account, project, location and the current state of the targets, and asks you to Proceed or Cancel.

language.title: Language
language.description: UI language: auto (from LC_ALL / LC_MESSAGES / LANG), en, zh-TW or ja

hold.title: What to hold
hold.description: destructive: delete-class commands only; mutating: delete and update-class; all: also create-class

include_gsutil.title: Also watch gsutil
include_gsutil.description: Hold gsutil rm, rb, cp, mv, rsync, setmeta, iam/acl changes and the like

hold_config_set.title: Hold gcloud config set
hold_config_set.description: Changing the active project or account silently changes what later commands hit, so it is held too

show_context.title: Show the context line
show_context.description: A dim line above the prompt with the gcloud project, account, configuration and the current GKE cluster, read from the config files

show_other_contexts.title: Show non-GKE kubectl contexts
show_other_contexts.description: Also show the current kubectl context when it is not a GKE cluster (docker-desktop, EKS, ...)

describe_timeout_seconds.title: Describe timeout (seconds)
describe_timeout_seconds.description: How long each read-only lookup (config get-value, describe, ls) may take before it is reported as failed; 3 to 60

band_style.title: Band style
band_style.description: How this mod's line above the prompt is framed: box (a rounded frame), rule (a thin line beneath), plain (text only)
